public_rationale: Later reporting says the FTC inquiry began during the summer and was publicly confirmed on September 30. That challenges an unrestricted claim of no investigation, but does not contradict Marcus's explicit fallback that nothing was public by September 25. Nor does the search establish the absence of all qualifying public action. The cited incident evidence also does not verify every victim category in his premise.
limitations: The FTC timing comes from reputable reporting quoting an agency spokesperson; no readable primary announcement establishing the relevant public-disclosure date was obtained.
September 30 developments cannot themselves be scored as events inside the observation period.
A broader reading covering unrelated inquiries could produce a different assessment.

statement.excerpt: And he has done absolutely nothing (or at least nothing public) to sanction or investigate OpenAI, even after its repeated attacks on foreign governments, companies and universities and who knows what else.
statement.document_title: BREAKING: OpenAI’s epic meltdown — and how Sam Altman is blowing up Jensen Huang’s reputation

from_speaker: even after its repeated attacks on foreign governments, companies and universities
our_interpretation: The explicit qualification limits the defensible assertion to publicly known action by Trump or his administration as of publication.
The surrounding discussion makes investigations or sanctions concerning the security incidents the primary scope. An unrelated inquiry would not automatically settle that reading.
The observation covers the current administration through September 25, 2026.
Congressional inquiries, state investigations, and foreign-government investigations are not actions by the Trump administration.
The attacks are an embedded factual premise, not a conditional-forecast antecedent. Model activity must be distinguished from deliberate attacks ordered by OpenAI.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable records establish repeated relevant incidents and sufficiently document the absence of a public federal executive investigation or sanction concerning them through publication.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A qualifying federal executive investigation or sanction was publicly announced by publication, or reliable incident findings refute the asserted repeated attacks.
